evals.name: simple-calculation
evals.prompt: Run a quick Python snippet to work out 30% commission and a 1.5% + 20p card fee on a £19.00 order
evals.expected_output: A short snippet is run and reports £5.70 commission and £0.485 card fee

evals.name: inspect-project-settings
